Draw as simplified hand-painted 2D game art with restrained firm dark outlines and broad readable surfaces; no realistic photograph, no elaborate illustration on the cover. The closed journal lies flat, spine at left, top of journal at top of image, completely inside square canvas with ample transparent padding. Slight dimensional edge, no cast shadow, no scenery, no hands, no person, no floor. No lettering, logos, tape, cassette, plastic sleeve, UI or watermark. Genuine alpha transparent background; item sprite crisp and recognizable at 128 pixels. Output one PNG.
